sections.text: John arrives at the school football field during the morning break. His friends are already picking teams for a match.

consequence.text: A defender tackles John while fighting for the ball.

sections.text: John gets back up after the tackle and continues playing near the opponent's goal.
John stays in defense and helps his team stop an attack.

options.description: Clear the ball up the field

sections.text: John shoots and scores. His friends cheer as his team takes the lead.
The pass reaches a teammate, and the team keeps possession of the ball.
John dribbles forward from defense and nearly reaches the penalty area.
The game continues for a few more minutes. Suddenly, the school bell rings, and everyone has to head back to class.
